Altitude effect negligible for iron because it's solid metal; but if we consider vaporization, boiling point changes slightly. But the function might compute using some model. Then for iron at 0m: get_boiling_melting_points({"substance":"iron","sea_level":0}). Then for iron at 1000m: get_boiling_melting_points({"substance":"iron","sea_level":1000}).
